integrity: The claimed seven-ray impossibility is established by a symbolic exhaustive blow-up recurrence; the unbounded existence assertion uses an explicit two-step local fan construction. Finite repeated examples are supplemental checks, not an inductive proof.
scientific_limitations: Smooth complete split complex toric surfaces only. An existence spectrum, not an isomorphism classification; it uses the published toric tensor-generation criterion and classical surface classification. The exact exhaustive finite blow-up check is supplied; full comparative access to the remaining sections of the motivating paper was unavailable. Historical priority is provisional; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: The seven-ray gap for tensor-generating canonical bundles on smooth toric surfaces
